packages.name: @earendil-works/pi-agent-core
packages.reason: Pi owns the agent loop (PRD decisions 13 and 31) and is adapted at the RunSession seam in slice 5.3. Pinned exactly so an upgrade is a reviewed change paired with the golden-corpus replay, never a silent lockfile move.

images.name: node
images.reason: The build and runtime base for every stage of the root Dockerfile. The tag carries the exact Node version from .nvmrc, which pnpm's devEngines check refuses to substitute, and the digest keeps the stack on the image it was built and tested with.

images.name: postgres
images.reason: The production major (PRD stack decision 11). The testkit harness boots it and the integration tier pulls it; the digest keeps both on the image the tier was proven against.
